dependencies.relationship: Principal EU framework for Union citizen residence, family members, residence cards, retained/permanent residence and equal treatment.

relevant_shared_case_law.topic: Article 3(2), mobile citizen return route and review
Dutch or other citizen returning after genuine residence in another Member State

dependencies.review_state: The relevant national provisions and guidance are identified, but the Article 2(2) / Article 3(2) category and remedy crosswalk remains open.

dependencies.instrument: Agreement on the European Economic Area
dependencies.relationship: Provides the distinct EEA basis for Icelandic, Liechtenstein and Norwegian nationals and qualifying family members.
dependencies.review_state: IND pages group EEA nationals with EU citizens; exact treaty incorporation and any route-specific limits are not mapped.

dependencies.instrument: EU-Switzerland Agreement on the free movement of persons
dependencies.relationship: Provides a separate Swiss free-movement basis; do not treat it as an automatic application of Directive 2004/38.
dependencies.review_state: Operational IND guidance groups Swiss nationals with EU/EEA nationals; map the relevant agreement and family rights separately.

dependencies.relationship: Separate residence status for protected Withdrawal Agreement beneficiaries; not a current general free-movement route for new UK arrivals.
dependencies.review_state: IND route identified; beneficiary dates, family scope and appeal route still need mapping.

dependencies.instrument: Directive 2003/86/EC on the right to family reunification
dependencies.relationship: Relevant to ordinary third-country sponsor family reunification and distinct from Directive 2004/38.
dependencies.review_state: The IND routes are identified; map the national implementing rules, documentary requirements, refusal reasons and remedies separately from EU free movement.

dependencies.relationship: Governs Schengen short-stay visa procedure; EU-family facilitation requires a separate decision path and applicable derogations.
dependencies.review_state: Map the Visa Code and Directive 2004/38 family-member facilitation against mission instructions, appointment and service-fee practices. The nl-38 exact URL is not relied upon.

dependencies.relationship: Can simplify cross-border presentation of covered public documents, including civil-status documents, and restricts some apostille requirements.
dependencies.review_state: Check the covered document type, issuing EU state, multilingual form, translation, and exceptions before relying on a general legalization checklist.

dependencies.relationship: Historical residence-card format regime; declared invalid in CJEU judgment C-61/22, with effects maintained for a limited period pending replacement.
dependencies.review_state: Do not use Regulation 2019/1157 as the current standalone rule. Check the judgment's temporal effects and successor legislation.

dependencies.relationship: Successor security and format rules for identity cards and residence documents issued under free-movement law; Article 8 includes transition deadlines, including 3 August 2026.
dependencies.review_state: The relevant transition date has passed. The IND specimen page was last updated 29 June 2026; verify current Dutch Article 10/20 card specimens and any applicable transition exception.

dependencies.instrument: Wet basisregistratie personen, Besluit basisregistratie personen, and Regeling basisregistratie personen
dependencies.relationship: The BRP Act is implemented by the Besluit BRP and Regeling BRP; the three consolidated records are relevant to municipal registration and population-record procedures.
dependencies.review_state: The Act and two implementing rules are now identified as official consolidated links. Map their provisions to local municipal instructions, residence-duration thresholds, corrections, and registration evidence; the Regeling BRP result reviewed was dated and its live version should be checked for a specific issue.

dependencies.instrument: Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union, Article 47
dependencies.relationship: Effective judicial protection is relevant when mapping EU-law decisions and remedies, within the Charter's field of application.
dependencies.review_state: No decision-specific remedy, deadline or interim-relief crosswalk is complete.
